comments.body: As it turns out, this is already the case.
appears not to be the case after all.

The WebACFilter seems to be doing this already: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-auth-webac/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/auth/webac/WebACFilter.java#L97

DELETE on a resource is authorized only if the user has acl:Write permission.

Added unit test to ensure that acl:Append is not sufficient to DELETE a resource. Also, the 403 HTTP response code seems to be the appropriate code here, Should we change the issue's title from 401 to 403.

PR: https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/1340

I would suggest we also need an integration test for ensuring this behavior... which I believe implies a dependency on:

https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2760 and

https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-2763
